title: Engineering Load Measurement Note: kVA Measure for the Electric Service by Rate Schedule Seasonal Minimum
content:
**Note.** The seasonal minimum of an Electric Service by Rate Schedule irrigation account is measured on a capacity figure in kVA set by comparing the account's installed transformer kVA with the highest metered demand recorded on the account's demand charge lines.

| Highest metered demand on the account's demand charge lines | The minimum is measured on |
|---|---|
| Exceeds the transformer kVA | That metered demand |
| Below half the transformer kVA | Twice that metered demand |
| From half the transformer kVA up to the transformer kVA | The transformer kVA |

The figure so measured takes the place of the kVA in the guaranteed minimum, which is the minimum rate per kVA multiplied by that figure and by the portion of the year guaranteed, the product rounded once to the cent.

### Boundary cases (hypothetical 300 kVA transformer)

| Highest metered demand | Measure |
|---|---|
| 340 kW | 340 |
| 300 kW | 300 — not above the transformer kVA |
| 150 kW | 300 — exactly half is not below half |
| 149 kW | 298 |
| 120 kW | 240 |

### Point of reading

- The highest metered demand is the largest metered demand shown on any demand charge line of the same service account.
